reader_notes: Tight and well-paced; the three-sentence opening ('The forecasts proved good. The losses barely moved.') does a lot of work economically.
Distractors A and C are each contradicted by an explicit sentence, and D invents a mistrust motive the text never offers - all clean.

The closing formulation ('seldom short of warning, only of a cheap and easy way to act on it') states the keyed idea almost directly, so the item is on the easy side, which is appropriate for a short unit.
